#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ScriptDirectory=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
Settings="${ScriptDirectory}/settings"
Base=$(<"$Settings/base-dir")
AllowedDatabase=$(<"$Settings/allowed-database")
AllowedRole=$(<"$Settings/allowed-role")
AllowedIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/allowed-ipv4-cidr")
AllowedIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/allowed-ipv6-cidr")
AdminDatabases=$(<"$Settings/admin-databases")
AdminRole=$(<"$Settings/admin-role")
AdminIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/admin-ipv4-cidr")
AdminIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/admin-ipv6-cidr")
CommercialDatabase=$(<"$Settings/commercial-database")
CommercialRuntimeRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-runtime-role")
CommercialAuthorizerRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-authorizer-role")
CommercialMigratorRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migrator-role")
CommercialServiceIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-service-ipv4-cidr")
CommercialServiceIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-service-ipv6-cidr")
CommercialMigrationIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migration-ipv4-cidr")
CommercialMigrationIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migration-ipv6-cidr")
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
validate_identifier() { local Label=$1 Value=$2 Lower; [[ "$Value" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}$ ]] || fail "Invalid $Label identifier"; Lower=${Value,,}; case "$Lower" in all|sameuser|samerole|samegroup|replication) fail "Reserved HBA token is not allowed for $Label" ;; esac; }
validate_role() { validate_identifier "$1" "$2"; [[ "${2,,}" != amp ]] || fail 'The local AMP superuser cannot be exposed remotely'; }
validate_database_list() { local Value=$1 Item; [[ ${#Value} -le 511 && "$Value" != ,* && "$Value" != *, && "$Value" != *,,* ]] || fail 'Invalid administrative database list'; IFS=',' read -ra Items <<< "$Value"; ((${#Items[@]} >= 1 && ${#Items[@]} <= 8)) || fail 'Administrative database list must contain one to eight exact databases'; for Item in "${Items[@]}"; do validate_identifier 'administrative database' "$Item"; done; }
validate_cidr() { local Label=$1 Value=$2 Family=$3 ExactPrefix=$4 Address Prefix; [[ "$Value" =~ ^([^/]+)/([0-9]{1,3})$ ]] || fail "Invalid $Label CIDR"; Address=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; Prefix=$((10#${BASH_REMATCH[2]})); [[ "$Prefix" == "$ExactPrefix" ]] || fail "$Label must be an exact /$ExactPrefix host CIDR"; if [[ "$Family" == 4 ]]; then perl -MSocket=AF_INET,inet_pton -e 'exit(defined inet_pton(AF_INET, $ARGV[0]) ? 0 : 1)' "$Address" || fail "Invalid $Label IPv4 address"; else perl -MSocket=AF_INET6,inet_pton -e 'exit(defined inet_pton(AF_INET6, $ARGV[0]) ? 0 : 1)' "$Address" || fail "Invalid $Label IPv6 address"; fi; }
[[ "$Base" == /*/ && "$Base" != *$'\n'* && "$Base" != *$'\r'* ]] || fail 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
ResolvedBase=$(realpath -e -- "$Base") || fail 'Could not resolve AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
[[ "$ResolvedBase" == "$ScriptDirectory" ]] || fail 'HBA renderer path does not match the configured PostgreSQL base directory'
Base="${ResolvedBase}/"
validate_identifier 'primary database' "$AllowedDatabase"
validate_role 'primary role' "$AllowedRole"
validate_cidr 'primary' "$AllowedIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'primary' "$AllowedIPv6CIDR" 6 128
validate_database_list "$AdminDatabases"
validate_role 'administrative role' "$AdminRole"
validate_cidr 'administrative' "$AdminIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'administrative' "$AdminIPv6CIDR" 6 128
validate_identifier 'commercial database' "$CommercialDatabase"
validate_role 'commercial runtime role' "$CommercialRuntimeRole"
validate_role 'commercial authorizer role' "$CommercialAuthorizerRole"
validate_role 'commercial migrator role' "$CommercialMigratorRole"
validate_cidr 'commercial service' "$CommercialServiceIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'commercial service' "$CommercialServiceIPv6CIDR" 6 128
validate_cidr 'commercial migration' "$CommercialMigrationIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'commercial migration' "$CommercialMigrationIPv6CIDR" 6 128
declare -A SeenRoles=()
for Role in "$AllowedRole" "$AdminRole" "$CommercialRuntimeRole" "$CommercialAuthorizerRole" "$CommercialMigratorRole"; do Lower=${Role,,}; [[ -z "${SeenRoles[$Lower]+present}" ]] || fail 'Every remotely reachable PostgreSQL role must be distinct'; SeenRoles[$Lower]=present; done
[[ -f "${Base}data/PG_VERSION" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL data directory is not initialized'
Hba="${Base}data/pg_hba.conf"
Pending="${Base}data/pg_hba.remote.pending"
umask 077
HbaNext=$(mktemp "${Base}data/.pg_hba.conf.XXXXXX")
cleanup() { rm -f "$HbaNext"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
printf '%s\n' 'local all amp peer' 'local all all scram-sha-256' 'hostnossl all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject' 'hostnossl all all ::0/0 reject' > "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AllowedDatabase" "$AllowedRole" "$AllowedIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AllowedDatabase" "$AllowedRole" "$AllowedIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AdminDatabases" "$AdminRole" "$AdminIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AdminDatabases" "$AdminRole" "$AdminIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
for Role in "$CommercialRuntimeRole" "$CommercialAuthorizerRole"; do printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$Role" "$CommercialServiceIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"; printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$Role" "$CommercialServiceIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"; done
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$CommercialMigratorRole" "$CommercialMigrationIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$CommercialMigratorRole" "$CommercialMigrationIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
chmod 0600 "$HbaNext"
mv -f "$HbaNext" "$Pending"
HbaNext=$(mktemp "${Base}data/.pg_hba.conf.XXXXXX")
printf '%s\n' 'local all amp peer' 'local all all scram-sha-256' 'hostnossl all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject' 'hostnossl all all ::0/0 reject' > "$HbaNext"
chmod 0600 "$HbaNext"
mv -f "$HbaNext" "$Hba"
trap - EXIT
echo 'Staged deterministic remote HBA rules and installed local-only preflight HBA'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
StopRequested=0
record_stop_request() { StopRequested=1; }
trap record_stop_request TERM INT HUP
ScriptDirectory=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
Settings="${ScriptDirectory}/settings"
Base=$(<"$Settings/base-dir")
Port=$(<"$Settings/port")
fail() { echo "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ "$Base" == /*/ && "$Base" != *$'\n'* && "$Base" != *$'\r'* ]] || fail 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
[[ "$Port" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] && ((10#$Port >= 1 && 10#$Port <= 65535)) || fail 'Invalid PostgreSQL port'
ResolvedBase=$(realpath -e -- "$Base") || fail 'Could not resolve AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
[[ "$ResolvedBase" == "$ScriptDirectory" ]] || fail 'Supervisor path does not match the configured PostgreSQL base directory'
Data="${Base}data"
PidFile="${Data}/postmaster.pid"
ExpectedExecutable=$(readlink -f -- "${Base}pgsql/bin/postgres") || fail 'Could not resolve expected PostgreSQL executable'
[[ -x "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || fail 'Expected PostgreSQL executable is not executable'
TimeoutExecutable=$(command -v timeout) || fail 'GNU timeout is required by the lifecycle supervisor'
read_identity() {
  local -a PostmasterFields ProcFields
  local Pid PidData PidStartEpoch PidPort ResolvedPidData ActualExecutable ProcStat ProcRest ProcState ProcStartTime
  [[ -r "$PidFile" ]] || return 1
  mapfile -t PostmasterFields < <(head -n 4 -- "$PidFile")
  ((${#PostmasterFields[@]} == 4)) || return 1
  Pid=${PostmasterFields[0]}
  PidData=${PostmasterFields[1]}
  PidStartEpoch=${PostmasterFields[2]}
  PidPort=${PostmasterFields[3]}
  [[ "$Pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((10#$Pid > 1)) || return 1
  [[ "$PidStartEpoch" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((10#$PidStartEpoch > 0)) || return 1
  [[ "$PidPort" == "$Port" ]] || return 1
  ResolvedPidData=$(realpath -e -- "$PidData") || return 1
  [[ "$ResolvedPidData" == "$ResolvedBase/data" ]] || return 1
  [[ -r "/proc/${Pid}/stat" ]] || return 1
  ActualExecutable=$(readlink -f -- "/proc/${Pid}/exe") || return 1
  [[ "$ActualExecutable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || return 1
  ProcStat=$(<"/proc/${Pid}/stat") || return 1
  ProcRest=${ProcStat##*) }
  [[ "$ProcRest" != "$ProcStat" ]] || return 1
  read -ra ProcFields <<< "$ProcRest"
  ((${#ProcFields[@]} >= 20)) || return 1
  ProcState=${ProcFields[0]}
  ProcStartTime=${ProcFields[19]}
  [[ "$ProcState" != Z && "$ProcState" != X && "$ProcStartTime" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1
  printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$Pid" "$ProcStartTime" "$PidStartEpoch"
}
ManagedIdentity=$(read_identity) || fail 'Could not attach to the verified PostgreSQL postmaster'
IFS='|' read -r ManagedPid ManagedProcStartTime ManagedPidStartEpoch <<< "$ManagedIdentity"
process_matches_managed_identity() {
  local -a ProcFields
  local ActualExecutable ProcStat ProcRest ProcState
  [[ -r "/proc/${ManagedPid}/stat" ]] || return 1
  ActualExecutable=$(readlink -f -- "/proc/${ManagedPid}/exe") || return 1
  [[ "$ActualExecutable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || return 1
  ProcStat=$(<"/proc/${ManagedPid}/stat") || return 1
  ProcRest=${ProcStat##*) }
  [[ "$ProcRest" != "$ProcStat" ]] || return 1
  read -ra ProcFields <<< "$ProcRest"
  ((${#ProcFields[@]} >= 20)) || return 1
  ProcState=${ProcFields[0]}
  [[ "$ProcState" != Z && "$ProcState" != X && "${ProcFields[19]}" == "$ManagedProcStartTime" ]]
}
Stopping=0
ignore_repeat_signal() { :; }
stop_postgres() {
  local FinalStatus=${1:-0} CurrentIdentity
  if ((Stopping)); then return 0; fi
  Stopping=1
  trap ignore_repeat_signal TERM INT HUP
  CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity) || fail 'Refusing shutdown because PostgreSQL identity cannot be revalidated'
  [[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]] || fail 'Refusing shutdown because the PostgreSQL process identity changed'
  if "${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_ctl" stop --pgdata="$Data" --mode=fast --wait --timeout=30; then
    process_matches_managed_identity && fail 'pg_ctl reported success while the verified postmaster remained alive'
    echo 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster stopped cleanly'
    exit "$FinalStatus"
  fi
  if process_matches_managed_identity; then
    if CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity); then
      [[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL identity changed while shutdown was requested'
      fail 'PostgreSQL fast shutdown failed while the verified postmaster remained alive'
    fi
    fail 'PostgreSQL fast shutdown failed and the original postmaster remains alive after losing its PID file identity'
  fi
  echo 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster stopped while shutdown was requested'
  exit "$FinalStatus"
}
trap stop_postgres TERM INT HUP
if ((StopRequested)); then stop_postgres; fi
ReadinessStatus=0
"$TimeoutExecutable" --foreground --signal=TERM --kill-after=1 5 "${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_isready" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || ReadinessStatus=$?
if ((ReadinessStatus != 0)); then
  echo 'Verified PostgreSQL readiness probe failed; stopping the managed postmaster' >&2
  stop_postgres 1
fi
CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity) || fail 'PostgreSQL identity was lost during supervisor attachment'
[[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL identity changed during supervisor attachment'
echo 'AMP_POSTGRESQL_SUPERVISOR_READY'
while true; do
  sleep 1 &
  wait $! || true
  CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity) || fail 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster exited or lost its identity unexpectedly'
  [[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]] || fail 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster identity changed unexpectedly'
done
